items.en: Teen gunman kills three children and a teacher at Oregon elementary school
items.zh: 奧勒岡州本德市 Silver Rail 小學遭 16 歲少年持長槍攻擊，**3 名孩童（5、8、11 歲）與 1 名教師死亡**，另 1 名 7 歲學生與 1 名教師重傷；嫌犯被一名持槍民眾追入校舍擊斃
items.summary: A 16-year-old used a long gun to blast through the locked doors of Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, killing three children aged 5, 8 and 11, plus a teacher. A 7-year-old student and another teacher were critically injured. An armed community member pursued the shooter into the building and killed him. Mayor Melanie Kebler said a school should be a safe place where children can learn and feel secure. The attack revives the American debate over gun access and school security, since the suspect defeated a locked entrance rather than slipping in unnoticed. Authorities have not yet publicly detailed a motive, and the two wounded victims remain in critical condition.

items.en: Neo-Nazi teen arrested over alleged plot to attack Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois
items.zh: 19 歲自稱新納粹的 Alexandros Paporakis 涉謀劃攻擊伊利諾州奧羅拉最大印度教寺廟 —— AR-15 在現場卡彈，之後被 Taco Bell 同事通報而落網，家中查出步槍、數百發子彈、戰術裝備與宣言
items.summary: Police arrested 19-year-old Alexandros Paporakis, a self-described neo-Nazi, for allegedly planning a mass shooting at the largest Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois. His AR-15 jammed when he visited the temple on Sunday. A Taco Bell co-worker alerted authorities, who searched his mother's home and found a rifle, hundreds of rounds of ammunition, tactical gear and a written manifesto. He faces charges of making a terrorist threat and illegal gun possession. The case shows how a workplace tip can prevent extremist violence, and it adds to concern about hate-motivated plots targeting religious minorities in the United States.

items.en: Trump cancels Hegseth's plan to live-stream Fort Hood shooter's execution
items.zh: 川普叫停國防部長赫格塞思「直播 2009 年胡德堡槍擊案兇手哈桑槍決」的計畫（該案 13 死）；處決仍定於 12/3 執行，聯合國人權辦公室先前警告直播等同公開處刑
items.summary: President Trump called off Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's plan to live-stream the firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan, the former Army major who killed 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009. The execution remains scheduled for December 3. Trump said live-streaming might have been a strong deterrent for the world. The United Nations Human Rights Office had warned that broadcasting the killing would amount to a public execution. The Pentagon had announced the livestream on October 8, drawing criticism. The reversal ends an unprecedented plan but leaves in place a rare military firing squad execution, the first of its kind in decades.

items.en: Houthi strike on Aden presidential palace kills five
items.zh: 葉門胡塞武裝攻擊亞丁總統府，**5 人死亡**（含 2 名總理隨扈），總理本人未受傷；沙烏地稱利雅德哈立德國王國際機場近期遭近 24 次攻擊，已致 17 死、逾 300 傷
items.summary: Houthi forces struck the presidential palace in Aden, seat of Yemen's Saudi-backed government, killing five people, including two of the prime minister's bodyguards. The prime minister was unharmed. The attack follows Houthi strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure and nearly two dozen attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, which Saudi officials say killed 17 people and injured more than 300. The escalation shows the Yemen conflict spilling deeper into Saudi territory and targeting the internationally recognised government's core, raising risks for Gulf energy supplies and for any regional de-escalation efforts already strained by wider Middle East fighting.

items.en: Pentagon reportedly delays Iran school-bombing report until after midterms
items.zh: 彭博報導五角大廈高層擬把「伊朗南部學校遭轟炸」的內部調查報告壓到期中選舉之後才公布（該事件至少 156 死，含 120 名孩童、26 名教師）；另 10/5–10/11 荷姆茲海峽附近有 12 艘船遭攻擊
items.summary: Bloomberg reported that top Pentagon officials plan to hold back an internal report on an attack on a school in southern Iran until after the U.S. midterm elections at the earliest. The bombing killed at least 156 people, including 120 children and 26 teachers. Separately, maritime officials said 12 vessels were attacked near the Strait of Hormuz between October 5 and 11, and another oil tanker was struck. The delay raises accountability questions over civilian casualties, while continued shipping attacks threaten a chokepoint carrying a large share of global oil, with potential effects on fuel prices worldwide.

items.en: Israeli ad-tech firm used targeted ads to infect Al Jazeera journalists' devices with spyware
items.zh: 半島電視台指以色列廣告科技公司 Discover-Tech 以**精準廣告**向數十台記者裝置植入 Candiru 間諜軟體，Citizen Lab 證實 —— **這是第一個被公開確認的「透過廣告投遞 zero-click 商用間諜軟體」案例**（受害者不需點擊任何東西）
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports that an Israeli ad-tech firm, Discover-Tech, used targeted advertisements to infect dozens of devices belonging to its journalists with spyware made by Candiru, an Israeli company the U.S. government blacklisted in 2021. The digital-rights group Citizen Lab corroborated the findings. Researchers say it is the first public confirmation of zero-click mercenary spyware delivered through targeted ads, meaning victims did not need to click anything. The case matters because ordinary online advertising infrastructure can become an attack channel, making it harder for journalists, activists and ordinary users to defend themselves.
items.source: Democracy Now!（引述 Al Jazeera、Citizen Lab）

items.en: Oxford physicists recreate the Aharonov-Bohm effect on a hybrid trapped-ion quantum computer
items.zh: 牛津大學團隊在《Nature Physics》用**2 個量子位元 + 2 個振盪器**的混合離子阱量子電腦，重現 1959 年預測的阿哈羅諾夫–波姆效應：加入模擬磁通量後，粒子的兩條路徑破壞性干涉，**穿隧被完全抑制**
items.summary: Researchers at the University of Oxford, with colleagues in Madrid, used a hybrid trapped-ion quantum computer to reproduce the Aharonov-Bohm effect, predicted in 1959, where a charged particle responds to magnetic flux it never passes through. Two oscillators represented matter at two locations and two entangled qubits represented the connecting fields. Without simulated flux the particle tunneled freely around the loop; with flux, the two paths interfered destructively and tunneling stopped completely. A related University of Maryland study in Nature Physics simulated the Yukawa potential. The work shows quantum machines can simulate gauge-field physics, a step toward modelling particle-physics problems classical computers struggle with.

items.en: Physicists find light can spontaneously develop spinning regions in empty space
items.zh: 英國東安格利亞大學與南非金山大學在《Light: Science & Applications》發現：一道初始「無自旋」的光束在**自由空間**傳播時會自發長出左旋與右旋區域，**不需要透鏡、鏡子或特殊材料**，由光束內部拓樸決定位置
items.summary: Physicists at the University of East Anglia and the University of the Witwatersrand, including Kayn Forbes and Isaac Nape, report in Light: Science & Applications that a beam prepared in a balanced polarization configuration can start with no spin, then develop separate left- and right-handed spinning regions as it travels through free space. No lenses, mirrors or engineered materials are needed. The beam's internal topology sets where the regions appear, which Nape calls a tuning knob for light. Possible future uses include more sensitive drug and medical tests, compact chemical sensors, higher-capacity optical communications and quantum networks, though these remain prospective rather than demonstrated.

items.en: Brewers advance to World Series with NLCS sweep of Dodgers
items.zh: 密爾瓦基釀酒人在國聯冠軍賽 **4-0 橫掃**洛杉磯道奇，**奪下 1982 年以來第一座國聯冠軍**；第 4 戰大谷翔平 3 分砲先讓道奇 4-0 領先，Bauers 二壘打＋滿壘保送追平，Mitchell 六局全壘打逆轉 5-4
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers completed a four-game NLCS sweep of the Los Angeles Dodgers, according to CBS Sports. In Game 4 at Dodger Stadium on October 15, Shohei Ohtani's three-run homer gave Los Angeles a 4-0 lead, but Jake Bauers' two-run double and a bases-loaded walk tied it at 4-4. Garrett Mitchell then hit a go-ahead home run in the sixth for a 5-4 Milwaukee lead. A win clinched the Brewers' first pennant since 1982. The sweep ends the Dodgers' run and prompts talk of their dynasty ending, plus questions about Tarik Skubal's pending free agency.

items.en: Broncos beat Seahawks 17-14 in overtime on Thursday Night Football
items.zh: NFL 第 6 週：丹佛野馬延長賽 **17-14** 擊敗衛冕超級盃冠軍西雅圖海鷹 —— Lutz 53 碼射門絕殺，野馬 5 次擒殺、3 次製造失誤；戰績野馬 4 勝 2 敗、海鷹 3 勝 3 敗
items.summary: Denver beat reigning Super Bowl champion Seattle 17-14 in overtime on October 15. The Broncos led 14-3 after RJ Harvey's one-yard touchdown, but Seattle scored 11 unanswered fourth-quarter points, including a Rashid Shaheed two-point catch and a Jason Myers field goal, to force overtime. Ja'Quan McMillian intercepted Sam Darnold, who finished 27-of-51 for 278 yards and two interceptions, setting up Wil Lutz's 53-yard winning field goal. Denver had five sacks and three takeaways despite Bo Nix throwing for just 107 yards. Denver improved to 4-2 while Seattle fell to 3-3, 2.5 games behind San Francisco.

items.en: Prescott urges NFL players to speak up after Eagles QB Jalen Hurts' blood clot diagnosis
items.zh: 費城老鷹四分衛 Jalen Hurts 小腿被診斷出淺層血栓（飛抵倫敦後的超音波才發現），追蹤檢查顯示位置移動，確定缺席第 6 週對黑豹；達拉斯牛仔 Dak Prescott 呼籲球員「把所有不舒服都告訴醫療團隊」
items.summary: Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott warned NFL players to be open with medical staff after Philadelphia's Jalen Hurts was diagnosed with a superficial blood clot in his calf. Hurts received calf treatment on October 8; an ultrasound after the Eagles flew to London for the Week 5 game against Jacksonville found the clot, and doctors cleared him to play. A follow-up scan showed it had moved, so he was ruled out of the Week 6 game against Carolina. Prescott called the situation scary because it involves someone's life, said players should tell medical staff everything, and credited physical therapist Luke Miller. Tanner McKee is expected to start.

items.en: Yale scientists discover how stress hormone cortisol makes emotional memories stronger
items.zh: 耶魯大學 Elizabeth Goldfarb 團隊（《Science Advances》）以**雙盲、安慰劑對照、受試者內設計**發現：皮質醇讓情緒網路活動更一致、記憶網路更專門化，並提高兩者的協調度，**可預測隔天的回憶表現**。研究者建議：把新教材連到「有情緒強度的素材」上，壓力下反而更記得住
items.summary: Yale researchers led by Elizabeth Goldfarb, published in Science Advances, gave participants hydrocortisone or a placebo in a double-blind design, with each person completing both conditions. While in an fMRI scanner they viewed pictures and rated emotional reactions, then were tested on memory the next day. Cortisol made emotion-network activity more consistent, made memory networks more specialized for emotional content, and increased coordination between the two. Analyzing brain connectivity over roughly five-second trials, the team predicted both emotional intensity and next-day recall. Goldfarb suggests linking new material to emotionally engaging elements may help students learn under stress. The work was NIH-funded.

items.en: Handling stress better may start at breakfast, Binghamton University study of college students finds
items.zh: 賓漢頓大學針對約 **400 名大學生**的匿名調查（《Journal of American College Health》）：**每週至少 5 天吃早餐**、**睡滿 6 小時**、**單次運動 20 分鐘以上**，都與較高的心理彈性與抗壓力相關；睡不到 6 小時則相反。⚠️ 這是問卷研究，只能說相關、不能說因果
items.summary: A Binghamton University team led by Lina Begdache surveyed about 400 college students anonymously on diet, sleep, exercise and other habits, publishing in the Journal of American College Health. Eating breakfast at least five days a week was linked to greater resilience, with psychological flexibility partly explaining the connection. Sleeping fewer than six hours was tied to lower resilience and flexibility, while activity lasting 20 minutes or more was linked to better coping. Fish oil several times weekly and frequent fast food also showed associations. Because the study is survey-based it shows correlation, not causation, but it points to cheap lifestyle levers for student mental health.

items.en: AI can act exactly like a human, but people still don't think it is conscious
items.zh: 慕尼黑大學 Louis Longin、Ophelia Deroy 團隊（《Cognition》，約 1,100 名受試者）：**即使是反應最積極的 AI，其「意識」評分仍低於反應最少的人類** —— 相同行為並不換來相同評價；但在「覺察（awareness）」這個詞上，人與 AI 的判斷模式卻相似
items.summary: Researchers at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München, led by Louis Longin with Ophelia Deroy and colleagues, tested nearly 1,100 participants in a study published in Cognition. People judged characters as more conscious and aware when they responded more actively to their surroundings, whether AI or human. Yet even the most responsive AI was rated less conscious than the least responsive human, so identical behavior did not earn equal ratings. For the word awareness, judgments of humans and AI followed similar patterns. The authors suggest consciousness implies subjective experience while awareness is seen as behavior-based, which matters for how people trust and relate to AI.

items.en: Some investors push Anthropic to cut November IPO valuation to $1.5 trillion as growth slows
items.zh: 路透 10/15：部分現有與潛在投資人考慮以 **1.5 兆美元**估值參與 Anthropic 11 月 IPO（原先預期約 2 兆）；**Q3 營收 168 億美元、季增 45%**（Q2 為 116 億），成長率從「幾乎翻倍」明顯放緩；9 月招股書顯示 2025 年虧損 420 億美元、十年期算力與雲端承諾至少 5,180 億美元
items.summary: Reuters reported on October 15 that some current and prospective investors are weighing a $1.5 trillion valuation for Anthropic's planned November IPO, down from roughly $2 trillion earlier expectations. The figure came up at an investor day at Anthropic's San Francisco headquarters. Anthropic told investors Q3 revenue reached $16.8 billion, up 45% from Q2's $11.6 billion, a clear slowdown from the previous near-doubling. Its September prospectus showed a $42 billion loss for 2025 and at least $518 billion in ten-year compute and cloud commitments. The shift matters because Amazon and Alphabet, both major Anthropic shareholders, booked huge paper gains, and a lower price would shrink future gains and signal how markets value frontier AI growth.

items.en: TSMC posts record Q3 results and guides Q4 revenue up about 58% as AI demand outpaces supply
items.zh: 台積電 Q3 營收 **467 億美元、季增 16.2%**（超出財測上緣）、EPS 29.43 元、**毛利率 66.4%（主要被 2 奈米量產稀釋而下滑 1.3 個百分點）**；Q4 財測 **523–543 億美元（年增約 58%）**、毛利率 65–67%；**2026 年資本支出維持 600–640 億美元**，新竹與高雄 2 奈米產能預計 2027 年倍增以上
items.summary: TSMC reported record third-quarter results on October 15, its sixth straight quarter of record profit, driven by AI chip demand. Revenue was $46.7 billion, up 16.2% from the prior quarter and above the top of its guidance, with EPS of NT$29.43. Gross margin was 66.4%, down 1.3 points mainly because of dilution from the 2nm ramp. Q4 guidance is $52.3 to $54.3 billion, roughly 58% year over year, with gross margin of 65 to 67%. The 2026 capex budget stays at $60 to $64 billion, and 2nm capacity in Hsinchu and Kaohsiung is expected to more than double in 2027. This anchors Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain outlook, from equipment to materials suppliers.

items.en: IonQ launches $2 billion equity offering days after $1.3 billion all-stock Elisity deal, rattling quantum stocks
items.zh: IonQ 10/14 宣布 **20 億美元現金增資**（J.P. Morgan 獨家承銷，另含 1 億股七年期認股權證），數日前才以最高 **13 億美元全股票**收購資安公司 Elisity；IonQ 當日跌約 **6% 至 32.76 美元**，D-Wave 與 Rigetti 各跌約 **4%**，隔日反彈。IonQ 同時上調 2026 年營收展望至 2.80–2.90 億美元
items.summary: IonQ priced a $2 billion equity offering on October 14, selling common stock and pre-funded warrants to an entity managed by Heights Capital, with J.P. Morgan as sole underwriter. The package includes seven-year warrants for 100 million more shares at a much higher exercise price. Days earlier, IonQ agreed to buy cybersecurity firm Elisity in an all-stock deal worth up to $1.3 billion. IonQ shares fell about 6% to $32.76, and D-Wave and Rigetti each dropped about 4%, though the group rebounded the next day. IonQ raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $280 to $290 million after Q2 revenue of $80.05 million, but dilution is now the key investor concern for quantum names.

market.highlight: **一句話：昨天的問題是「外資會連 8 賣還是轉買」，答案是連 8 賣 —— 但力道只剩 1/6。**台股 10/16 收 **47,111.26、漲 141.39 點（+0.30%）**，成交約 9,359 億元（量縮）。台積電法說後仍收跌 **2,420 元（-20 元、-0.82%）**、單一檔拖累指數約 160 點，但**聯發科（+2.04%，傳取得 ByteDance AI 晶片訂單、終結 7 連跌）、PCB 與低軌衛星族群領漲**，金融類股 +0.99%。**外資賣超 461.47 億元（連 8 賣，但比前一天的 3,025.55 億元收斂到約 1/6）**，三大法人合計賣超 678.07 億元，**投信買超 117.54 億元（連 6 買）**。清單內唯一 ≥5% 的是**奇鋐 +7.46%（收 3,315 元）**，華通盤中觸及漲停。**但真正的重點在美股：同一天那斯達克 -2.14%、S&P -1.09%、費半 -3.83%（30 檔成分股全跌）、CoreWeave -11.91%**，殺的是**AI 的融資面**而不是 AI 需求。**台股本週累計仍下跌 2,202 點。**
market.note: ★ **給你的三個觀察重點（不是建議，是下週一開盤該看哪裡）**：　**①10/16 台股的 +0.30% 不是「對美股的回答」，而是「問題還沒被問」。**台股 13:30 收盤，美股 21:30 才開。所以**那斯達克 -2.14%、費半 -3.83% 這兩個數字，台股要等到 10/19（一）開盤才第一次反映** —— 而本週台股已經累計跌 2,202 點。**下週一開盤的第一個小時，是這一整週最有資訊量的時段。**　**②這次美股殺的是「借錢買 GPU 的商業模式」，不是 AI 需求本身。**證據很乾淨：**CoreWeave -11.91%（收 61.39 美元、週跌 25.21%，債務超過 510 億美元、公司債以 distressed 水準交易）**、Nebius -12.18%，而同一天 **10 年期美債殖利率 5.09%、Brent 原油約 109.88 美元、VIX 跳升 21.45% 到 19.99**。**殖利率 + 油價 + 高槓桿，三個一起動，受傷最重的一定是「先借錢買設備再出租」的模式。**台積電 Q4 財測年增約 58%、2026 資本支出維持 600–640 億美元 —— **需求端完全沒有轉弱，這是兩件不同的事，不要混在一起讀。**　**③記憶體是另一條獨立的線：MU -5.63%。**原因不是 AI，是**中國長鑫（CXMT）的 4F2 DRAM 進展可能緩解缺貨、壓抑現貨價**。你清單內的南亞科（+1.82%）、華邦電、旺宏屬於同一條線 —— **下週一要分開看「AI 融資面」和「DRAM 供給面」這兩個完全不同的故事。**　★ **一個你清單的健檢發現**：奇鋐（3017，風險「高」）10/16 **+7.46%**，而前一天它是 -6.94%。**兩天之內 ±7%，這就是標示「高」的實際含義** —— 標示準確，不需要調整。
